Conference season took Rodrigo Gomez-Fell from Oslo to Sherbrooke. At the SCAR Open Science
Conference in Oslo he presented a poster and a lightning talk; in Canada he spoke at the ASAR
Workshop/RCM Users' Forum and gave a guest lecture at the Université de Sherbrooke. The
presentations are listed under [Conference papers and abstracts](../publications.qmd#conference),
and the lecture on the [Teaching](../teaching.qmd#lectures) page.
